style.styleTitle: Nutcracker Personalised First Christmas Bauble by No Ordinary Gift
style.toneOfVoice: Celebrate a little one s first Christmas with this personalised Nutcracker bauble. It can be personalised with the child s name, surname, date and First Christmas year, displayed on the banner. The design is printed onto a wooden insert and displayed inside a clear glass bauble with artificial snow, finished with a velvet ribbon in your choice of colour. A traditional personalised First Christmas decoration, Nutcracker Christmas ornament and keepsake gift.
